CandidateCard.description: Summary level only (spec §7.1): no history, feedback or contact data.
CandidateCard.title: CandidateCard

DisputeCreate.description: The worker is the caller; a body never names a worker (spec §7.1).
DisputeCreate.title: DisputeCreate

DisputeStatusRead.description:
What detail-level viewers see (spec §7.1 "disputes status"): no reason
or notes text, which only the worker and People Ops read.
DisputeStatusRead.title: DisputeStatusRead

EngagementCreate.description: Terms a PM confirms (FR-4.3/4.4). Workers are addressed in the path.
EngagementCreate.title: EngagementCreate

FirstShotPanel.description:
The mandatory first-shot resource (FR-4.6): shown on the same page as
candidates, never hideable.
FirstShotPanel.title: FirstShotPanel

FirstShotReviewCreate.description:
FR-4.7: an outcome, and a fixed reason code when passing. `engaged` is
not accepted: it is recorded when the PM actually engages the worker on the
project (roster.mark_first_shot_engaged).
FirstShotReviewCreate.title: FirstShotReviewCreate

GovernanceOverview.description: FR-7.1 / FR-4.8: concentration, dispute volume, tier distribution.
GovernanceOverview.title: GovernanceOverview

PassReason.description: Fixed reason codes for passing on a first-shot candidate (FR-4.7).
PassReason.title: PassReason

PrefillTerms.description:
Prefill carries the scope only: access notes (credentials, VPN and
site details) belong to one engagement and need detail visibility.
PrefillTerms.title: PrefillTerms

ReactivationPrefill.description:
Contract terms from the most recent engagement (FR-4.4). No history,
no feedback, no access notes: prefill needs only summary visibility.
ReactivationPrefill.title: ReactivationPrefill

ScoreBreakdown.description: Every candidate carries how its score was made (spec §7.4).
ScoreBreakdown.title: ScoreBreakdown

StandingExplanation.description: Tier, signals and policy version (spec §2.1 #2, FR-1.3).
StandingExplanation.title: StandingExplanation

StandingOverrideCreate.description: Spec §7.2 / §8.1: a manual tier change always carries a reason.
StandingOverrideCreate.title: StandingOverrideCreate

StructuredAnswers.description: FR-2.3 — behaviour-specific questions; all required, nothing else.
StructuredAnswers.title: StructuredAnswers

WorkerUpdate.description: Self-editable fields only (FR-1.5). Unknown fields are rejected.
WorkerUpdate.title: WorkerUpdate
